==Teleportation==
To be able to use it, torn pages obtained from completing quests in [[Great Kourend]] must be used on it. Each page unlocks a location in one of the five cities of Great Kourend that the player can teleport to by using the ''Reminisce'' option on the memoirs. Each teleport uses up one charge. The memoirs will teleport the player near a patch of lancalliums, rare roses which were King Kharedst IV's favourite flowers, found within each of the five cities.

Each torn page added onto the memoirs will give it 20 teleport charges, as well as increase the maximum number of charges available.

Players cannot teleport past level 20 [[Wilderness]].
